5712-sculpture-of-the-exposition-palaces.creator: Juliet James
5712-sculpture-of-the-exposition-palaces.description: A book by Juliet James. The sculpture has vitalized the whole marvelous Exposition. It is not an accessory, as has been the sculpture of previous Expositions, but it goes hand in hand with the architecture, poignantly existing for its own sake and adding greatly to the decorative architectural effects. In many cases the architecture is only the background or often only a pedestal for the figure or group, pregnant with spirit and meaning.

59448-mary-wollstonecraft-and-the-beginn.title: Mary Wollstonecraft And The Beginnings Of Female Emancipatio
59448-mary-wollstonecraft-and-the-beginn.creator: Unknown
59448-mary-wollstonecraft-and-the-beginn.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. me to determine my choice of a subject for an inaugural dissertation. It was while engaged upon tracing the influence of Rousseau's hopebringing theories on his English disciple William Godwin, that the less boldly assertive, but all the more humanly attractive personality of the latter's first wife, Mary Wollstonecraft, attracted my attention. My admiration of her husband's intellect paled before my sympathy for her more modest, but at the same time more emotional character.

arxiv-2105-04827.title: New type of self-oscillating systems
arxiv-2105-04827.creator: V.V. Sargsyan 1 , A.A. Hovhannisyan 1,2,3 , G.G. Adamian 1 , N.V. Antonenko 1,4 , and D. Lacroix 5
arxiv-2105-04827.description: Abstract The time evolution of occupation number is studied for a bosonic oscillator (with one and two degrees of freedom) linearly fully coupled to fermionic and bosonic heat baths. The absence of equilibrium in this oscillator is discussed as a tool to create a dynamical non-stationary memory storage.

arxiv-2111-10234.title: Command Governors with Inexact Optimization and without Invariance
arxiv-2111-10234.creator: Emanuele Garone, Ilya V. Kolmanovsky
arxiv-2111-10234.description: Abstract 1 Introduction R eference Governors (RGs) [ 1 ] are add-on schemes to nominal closed-loop systems used to enforce pointwise-in-time state and control constraints. An RG acts as a safety supervisor for the reference commands (set-points) given to the closed-loop system by a human operator or by a higher-level planner in autonomous vehicles.

arxiv-2201-02758.title: Self-orthogonal generalized twisted Reed-Solomon codes
arxiv-2201-02758.creator: Canze Zhu, Qunying Liao
arxiv-2201-02758.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, by calculating the dual code of the Schur square for the standard twisted Reed-Solomon code, we give a sufficient and necessary condition for the generalized twisted Reed-Solomon code with h+t\leq k-1 to be self-orthogonal, where k is dimension, h is hook and t is twist.

arxiv-2203-14997.title: Intermediate determinism in general probabilistic theories
arxiv-2203-14997.creator: Victoria J Wright
arxiv-2203-14997.description: Abstract Quantum theory is indeterministic, but not completely so. When a system is in a pure state there are properties it possesses with certainty, known as actual properties. The actual properties of a quantum system (in a pure state) fully determine the probability of finding the system to have any other property. We call this feature intermediate determinism.

arxiv-2205-14133.title: The Derived Pure Spinor Formalism as an Equivalence of Categories
arxiv-2205-14133.creator: Chris ELLIOTT a, Fabian HAHNER b and Ingmar SABERI c
arxiv-2205-14133.description: Abstract We construct a derived generalization of the pure spinor superfield formalism and prove that it exhibits an equivalence of dg-categories between multiplets for a supertranslation algebra and equivariant modules over its Chevalley–Eilenberg cochains. This equivalence is closely linked to Koszul duality for the supertranslation algebra.

arxiv-2403-09812.title: BANG-MaNGA: A census of kinematic discs and bulges across mass and star formation in the local Universe
arxiv-2403-09812.creator: Fabio Rigamonti ,, Luca Cortese, Francesco Bollati, Stefano Covino, Massimo Dotti, A. Fraser-McKelvie, Francesco Haardt
arxiv-2403-09812.description: Abstract In this work, we aim to quantify the relevance of kinematically identified bulges and discs and their role in the process of galaxy quenching. To achieve this, we utilize an analysis of the SDSS-MaNGA survey conducted with the GPU-based code bang which simultaneously models galaxy photometry and kinematics to decompose galaxies into their structural components.

arxiv-2409-07359.creator: Thomas J. Kerby, Kevin R. Moon
arxiv-2409-07359.description: Abstract Training-free guidance methods for continuous data have seen an explosion of interest due to the fact that they enable foundation diffusion models to be paired with interchangable guidance models. Currently, equivalent guidance methods for discrete diffusion models are unknown.

arxiv-2501-13290.title: Stability of the long-range corrected exchange-correlation functional and the Proca procedural functional in time-dependent density-functional theory
arxiv-2501-13290.creator: Jared R. Williams, Carsten A. Ullrich
arxiv-2501-13290.description: Abstract Excitonic effects in the optical absorption spectra of solids can be described with time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT) in the linear-response regime, using a simple class of approximate, long-range corrected (LRC) exchange-correlation functionals. It was recently demonstrated that the LRC approximation can also be employed in real-time TDDFT to describe exciton dynamics.

arxiv-2503-04223.title: Spiking Meets Attention: Efficient Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution with Attention Spiking Neural Networks
arxiv-2503-04223.creator: Yi Xiao, Qiangqiang Yuan, Kui Jiang, Wenke Huang, Qiang Zhang, Tingting Zheng, Chia-Wen Lin, Liangpei Zhang
arxiv-2503-04223.description: Abstract Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are emerging as a promising alternative to traditional artificial neural networks (ANNs), offering biological plausibility and energy efficiency. Despite these merits, SNNs are frequently hampered by limited capacity and insufficient representation power, yet remain underexplored in remote sensing image (RSI) super-resolution (SR) tasks.

arxiv-2506-04507.title: SkimROOT: Accelerating LHC Data Filtering with Near-Storage Processing
arxiv-2506-04507.creator: \firstname Narangerelt \lastname Batsoyol, \firstname Jonathan \lastname Guiang, \firstname Diego \lastname Davila, \firstname Aashay \lastname Arora, \firstname Philip \lastname Chang, \firstname Frank \lastname Würthwein, \firstname Steven \lastname Swanson
arxiv-2506-04507.description: Abstract Data analysis in high-energy physics (HEP) begins with data reduction, where vast datasets are filtered to extract relevant events. At the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), this process is bottlenecked by slow data transfers between storage and compute nodes. To address this, we introduce SkimROOT, a near-data filtering system leveraging Data Processing Units (DPUs) to accelerate LHC data analysis.

pmc-11427991.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Non-natural chiral α,α-disubstituted α-amino acids (α,α-AAs) constitute an attractive α-aminoisobutyric acid (Aib) replacement for improving bioavailability of linear peptides as therapeutics due to the ability of these amino acids to induce the peptides to form helical structures.
